skill.displayName: 门诊收费与退费日结核对（免费版）

version.changelog: 正文新增「免费网页版」入口；名称取自 SKILL.md

llm.summary: The free local checker itself is limited and local, but its documentation pushes an optional paid-install flow that asks an agent to run mutable remote code and follow newly installed instructions.

dimensions.detail: The local runner imports only Node standard-library modules plus the packaged engine, reads the input file, and I found no file writes, network calls, credential reads, persistence, or privilege escalation in the shipped code.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The upgrade prompt uses `npx -y @alipay/agent-payment@latest install`, which downloads and executes a mutable package version without a pinned version or integrity check.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md provides a prewritten prompt telling an AI assistant to install a payment package, read a newly installed SKILL.md, and initiate purchase/install steps for another product; that is broader than the free reconciliation task.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The reviewed package does not establish persistence, but the documented upgrade path delegates control to externally installed onboarding instructions and additional skill installation outside this artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The shipped checker coherently reads a user-supplied outpatient cashier/refund table and runs local arithmetic/table checks, but the optional upgrade section shifts into buying and installing a separate paid skill.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want the free local Chinese-language checker and are comfortable ignoring the paid-upgrade prompt. Do not copy the provided purchase/install prompt into an agent unless you separately trust the SkillPay package, verify the exact package version/source, and intentionally approve each install and payment step.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: The referenced runner and engine were present in the workspace and fully inspected, so the coverage concern is downgraded for this review.
[RP1] unexpected: The unpinned `npx ...@latest` install in the optional purchase workflow is artifact-backed and materially expands execution beyond the reviewed local checker.
[SDI-1] unexpected: The paid-product purchase and installation instructions are disclosed as optional but go beyond the manifest's no-payment local-checker framing.
[SDI-4] expected: The free/withheld check split is disclosed in the Chinese description, usage output, and engine exports; the English summary is less complete but not independently dangerous.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only interface matches a China-specific outpatient reconciliation table; it is a usability/localization limitation, not the basis for the security verdict.
[T01] unexpected: The non-JSON successful output unconditionally prints an upgrade link before results; this is promotional output rather than local check logic and may influence agent workflows.
[T01] unexpected: The prewritten AI prompt for installing dependencies, loading new instructions, and initiating a purchase supports the Review verdict, though it does not prove malicious behavior by itself.
